evidence: Samples thickness and film microstructure were determined by X-Ray Reflectometry (XRR) and X-Ray Diffraction (XRD) with Cu Kα radiation (λ = 1.54 Å) using a X'Pert (Philips) diffractometer. High Resolution-Transmission Electron Microscopy (HR-TEM) was employed to study the first stages of film growth. Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) operated in tapping mode... Film composition and density were determined on thin films deposited on p-Si (100) substrates by ion beam techniques using a Van der Graaf accelerator. 74Ta was quantified by Rutherford Back Scattering (RBS) using 4He ions at 1.7 MeV. Chemical binding states for N 1s, C 1s and O 1s were studied by high resolution X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS). Field Emission-Scanning Electron Microscopy (FE-SEM) was carried out using an Ultra 55 (Carl Zeis) microscope.
